name: ai-stack
description: Useful AI things an engineer uses daily. Ships prodcheck (senior-engineer production review), prodtest (senior-QA test pass with Playwright), mergemain (context-aware merge of main into the current branch), shipit (clean commits and PRs, with or without AI attribution), and adonis-next-monorepo (scaffolds a verified AdonisJS + Next.js monorepo with enforced conventions).
